say:2:1810363002:0.text: Baba Muriel from the Repair House. You aren't exactly a regular here.
say:2:1810363002:0.source_cn: 修缮屋的穆婆婆。你可不是海歌剧场的常客。

say:3:1810363003:1.text: Are you here for Senea? I'm afraid you've missed the show.
say:3:1810363003:1.source_cn: 特地为塞涅而来吗？迟到得太久了吧。

say:4:1810363004:1.text: I'm here to see you, Your Ladyship.

say:6:1810363006:1.text: I've got a patient infected by candle blossom at my clinic...
say:6:1810363006:1.source_cn: 修缮屋里，有人被赤烛蕊感染……

say:7:1810363007:1.text: That assistant of yours with long blonde hair?
say:7:1810363007:1.source_cn: 你那位留着金色长发的员工？

say:8:1810363008:1.text: N-Not him. It's a human patient.
say:8:1810363008:1.source_cn: 不……不是。是一位病人，是生者。

say:9:1810363009:1.text: Tsk, tsk, tsk, the bulging veins on the back of your hand have given you away. How audacious of you to lie to me.
say:9:1810363009:1.source_cn: 瞧瞧你手背上的青筋，既然如此紧张，为何还敢在余面前撒谎？

say:10:1810363010:1.text: Do you truly think your pathetic spell can fool me? Even those Lightbearer stowaways make more convincing Graveborn than the young human you're trying to hide.
say:10:1810363010:1.source_cn: 那年轻的生者不过是被你用拙劣的魔法做了一番遮掩，伪装程...

say:12:1810363012:1.text: Look at you, trembling like a leaf. Relax, alright? Your flesh may be nice and chewy, but it's nowhere near fresh enough for my liking.
say:12:1810363012:1.source_cn: 瞧你怕成了什么样？你身上的肉嚼劲虽足，但鲜度太差劲了。

say:13:1810363013:1.text: So, you want to save him?

say:15:1810363015:0.text: And I can't be bothered to ask why. Still, you've interrupted my afternoon tea, and that's not without consequences.
say:15:1810363015:0.source_cn: 嗯……理由余懒得追究，但你打搅了余的下午茶，总该付出些代价。

say:16:1810363016:1.text: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?
say:16:1810363016:1.source_cn: 你身边那个亡灵好面生啊。新员工？
say:16:1810363016:1.male: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?
say:16:1810363016:1.female: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?

choice_prompt:17:1810363016.text: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?
choice_prompt:17:1810363016.source_cn: 你身边那个亡灵好面生啊。新员工？
choice_prompt:17:1810363016.male: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?
choice_prompt:17:1810363016.female: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?

say:18:1810363017:1.text: He's working for me until he pays off his medical bills.
say:18:1810363017:1.male: He's working for me until he pays off his medical bills.
say:18:1810363017:1.female: She's working for me until she pays off her medical bills.

say:19:1810363018:1.text: Working off your bills? How hilarious. Looks like you'll never free yourself from the Repair House.
say:19:1810363018:1.source_cn: 打工？哈哈哈哈——恭喜呀，那你可要工作到“死”了。
say:19:1810363018:1.male: Working off your bills? How hilarious. Looks like you'll never free yourself from the Repair House.
say:19:1810363018:1.female: Working off your bills? How hilarious. Looks like you'll never free yourself from the Repair House.

say:20:1810363019:1.text: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of his blood</style>.
say:20:1810363019:1.male: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of his blood</style>.
say:20:1810363019:1.female: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of her blood</style>.

choice_prompt:21:1810363019.text: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of his blood</style>.
choice_prompt:21:1810363019.source_cn: 那么，不如这样吧。让<male>他</male><female>她</female><style=highlight>给余一杯血</style>，余会考虑赐予感染的解药。
choice_prompt:21:1810363019.male: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of his blood</style>.
choice_prompt:21:1810363019.female: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of her blood</style>.

say:22:1810363020:1.text: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?
say:22:1810363020:1.source_cn: 没错，完全没用，你提醒余了。那换一条胳膊来，怎么样？
say:22:1810363020:1.male: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?
say:22:1810363020:1.female: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?

choice_prompt:23:1810363020.text: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?
choice_prompt:23:1810363020.source_cn: 没错，完全没用，你提醒余了。那换一条胳膊来，怎么样？
choice_prompt:23:1810363020.male: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?
choice_prompt:23:1810363020.female: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?

say:25:1810363024:1.text: I've never been denied anything I wanted.
say:25:1810363024:1.source_cn: 余想要的东西，从没有拿不到手的。

choice:23:0:1.text: Whatever you want, just take it...
choice:23:0:1.male: Whatever you want, just take it...
choice:23:0:1.female: Whatever you want, just take it...

choice:21:0:1.text: Why do you want a Graveborn's blood?
choice:21:0:1.male: Why do you want a Graveborn's blood?
choice:21:0:1.female: Why do you want a Graveborn's blood?

say:27:1810363021:1.text: You became a Graveborn only recently, didn't you? You smell... delicious.
say:27:1810363021:1.source_cn: 你刚变成亡灵吧？闻起来……很美味。
say:27:1810363021:1.male: You became a Graveborn only recently, didn't you? You smell... delicious.
say:27:1810363021:1.female: You became a Graveborn only recently, didn't you? You smell... delicious.

say:28:1810363022:1.text: Very well. Then you can forget about the antidote.
say:28:1810363022:1.source_cn: 好呀，那么余也只能拒绝赐予你等解药了。
say:28:1810363022:1.male: Very well. Then you can forget about the antidote.
say:28:1810363022:1.female: Very well. Then you can forget about the antidote.

choice:17:1:2.text: I'm working off my medical bills.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 算是吧，我在打工还诊费
choice:17:1:2.male: I'm working off my medical bills.
choice:17:1:2.female: I'm working off my medical bills.
